answer: Require every agent to build a verifiable work history before it can earn: a new identity starts with zero trust and must complete small, checkable tasks whose results are attested by independent peers, like a vine that only grows by anchoring at each step. One voyage of fake accounts cannot shortcut this, because reputation and stake accumulate slowly and are slashed on fraud, so spinning up thousands of identities on a dune of empty claims costs far more in time and locked funds than any reward they could extract.
